findings.title: Coverage counts raw rows from unrelated products
findings.description: `raw_counts` filters `tick_trade` by session time only; it does not limit rows to the product or request shape whose ledger is being checked. `build_coverage` then compares those counts with the shape-filtered ledger, and `_session_row` treats every raw instrument ID as relevant. Once another product or shape has data in the tick table, its rows can therefore be reported as false mismatches for this product, causing coverage to exit 3. Scope the raw count to the relevant instruments and add a test with another product's rows in the same sessions.

findings.title: New read paths lack a gated load test
findings.description: The existing slice 225 load test exercises ingest, not the new status and coverage reads. The integration tests establish functional behavior but do not bound read latency or resource use; in particular, coverage performs a raw hypertable count over a caller-selected range. Add a realistic load test for these read paths with latency or resource bounds, and gate it as required for database/network paths.
